# FarmChain

> Direct farm-to-buyer marketplace connecting verified Indian farmers directly with households, retail shops, restaurants, and wholesale bulk buyers with 0% broker fee.

## Core Features
- Direct Trade: Farmers list their harvest directly, setting fair farm-gate prices.
- Transparent Mandi Benchmarks: Live APMC / Agmarknet modal prices provide open price discovery without intermediaries taking 20-30% cuts.
- Flexible Fulfillment: Micro-lots for households (1-25 kg) and commercial demands for businesses (100-2,000 kg).
- Village Pickup & Delivery: Coordinated rural logistics connecting farm gate to doorstep.
- Safe Escrow Payouts: Buyer payments held safely and released to farmer's verified bank account upon delivery acceptance.

## Technology Stack
- Architecture: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS).
- Reliability: Point-in-time recovery WAL archiving, transaction pooling via PgBouncer, PostGIS geospatial indexing for rural routing.
